objective: Directly publish assistant product usage to a project-scoped audited web-api ledger using the current credential model and no outbox.
acceptance_criteria: CreateProductUsages accepts usageId, usageType, positive integer usages, unit, and occurredAt.
The product_usages entity embeds Audited, Mutable, and Organizational.
Tenant IDs come only from authenticated context.
The billing collector sends no assistant, conversation, message, provider, or arbitrary attribute fields.
Exact duplicates are idempotent within a project, conflicting duplicates fail, and the same usage ID is independent across projects.
One shared registry rejects unknown usage types and mismatched units.
Every supported recorder path receives billing through collectors.NewWithEnv.
PAT and project-key smoke modes directly create and verify usage rows.
No SDK or outbox changes are made.
accepted_tradeoffs: A failed direct RPC may lose usage because this scope explicitly excludes durable replay.
Billing enforcement remains disabled until operations accept observed delivery reliability.
verification_commands: go run ./tests/system/cmd/systemcheck product-usage-smoke --web-address localhost:9001 --postgres-host localhost --auth-mode both
make agent-finalize CHANGED_FILES="$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR HEAD | paste -sd, -)"
